name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.letterProj_mem_withExponents
summary: By mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff: letterProj(x) is an average of ζ-translates of x, which stay in frobKisinAinf, and it lies in the letter part.

steps.claim: letterProj(L, i)(x) = q⁻¹Σ_n (ω(i)⁻¹ζ)^n x lies in frobKisinAinf(L, l) (multiplication by ζ maps frobKisinAinf into itself, mulZeta.wittMap_mem_frobKisinAinf) and in letterPart(L, i) (letterProj_mem_letterPart); conclude by mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff.
steps.lean:
mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff.2 ⟨by simp [letterProj, letterOp, smul_pow,
  End.pow_apply, sum_mem, smul_of_tower_mem, smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (MapsTo.iterate
  (fun _ ↦ mulZeta.wittMap_mem_frobKisinAinf) _ H)], letterProj_mem_letterPart⟩
